title: DeviceAuthChallengeResponse
description: Challenge response returned by a receiver or server for mutual home device authentication.

challenge_id.description: Unique UUID for this active authentication challenge.

challenge_nonce.description: Cryptographic nonce in base64url (at least 16 bytes / 22 chars).

server_michi_id.description: Server or receiver michi_id (43 chars base64url).

server_public_key.description: Server or receiver Ed25519 public key (43 chars base64url).
